capabilities: Sync parent checkbox status from child checkbox statuses
Configure ordered rules with ALL/ANY quantifiers and status expressions
Ignore checkboxes inside code blocks, frontmatter, math blocks, comments, and blockquotes
Opt individual notes out of cascade sync via frontmatter
Append a delete tag to tasks using the #task. shortcut
extras: Version 1.0.0 and later requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer (declarative settings API); users on older Obsidian versions must install release 0.2.2.
problem: Obsidian task checkboxes do not update a parent item's status automatically when its child tasks change state.

relations.evidence: Checkbox Autochecker (by klaasklee) – offers predefined 3 propagation modes
Checkbox Sync (by groldsf) – focus on multi-status logic

summary: Rule-based plugin that keeps parent checkbox statuses in sync with their children in task lists, with configurable propagation rules.
